_purpose: R119 registry of external request budgets. scripts/check_budget_degradation.py fails closed on any budget in Settings that is not registered here. A budget that terminates a run must say why; a budget that degrades must name the test that proves it keeps the work already done.

max_external_search_requests_per_run.note: Records `[external_search_budget_exceeded] <query>` and stops the branch. Re-raises only when nothing was obtained at all, which is a run that could not begin rather than one whose work is being discarded.

max_external_fetch_requests_per_run.note: This is the budget that emptied R113's Q03 and Q05: 20/20 spent, the twenty-first refused, the exception unwound the graph, and the sources already collected never reached research_join.

max_authority_search_requests_per_run.note: Refused through the same ToolErrorKind.BUDGET_EXCEEDED path as the general search budget, so the same degradation applies.

max_authority_fetch_requests_per_run.note: Same path as the general fetch budget.

max_searches_per_run.note: Returns False rather than raising, so it degrades by construction. Registered so a change to that -- turning the quota into an exception -- has to pass this guard first.
